summary: Prompt caching and cache usage. Anthropic Messages (not the DeepSeek dialect) marks two ephemeral cache_control breakpoints: the last system block and the last block of the newest user message. Responses and Codex requests made inside a session send prompt_cache_key = the session id (ad-hoc legacy-scope calls and the DeepSeek dialect send none). Usage gains cache_read_tokens / cache_write_tokens (serialized only when non-zero, so stored usage stays byte-identical otherwise): Anthropic cache_read_input_tokens / cache_creation_input_tokens, OpenAI Chat prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, Responses input_tokens_details.cached_tokens, Gemini cachedContentTokenCount. input_tokens keeps meaning the whole prompt, cached tokens included.
